title: Join every graph event to its graph, recipe, and authority
narrative: Nubble loads graph events into a warehouse and cannot afford to open checkpoints to learn which graph, recipe, or authorization epoch produced a row. A multi-node run with a nested subgraph must stamp every event with the same graph id, recipe stamp, and epoch, and nested runs must point at their parent run so a flat table can rebuild per-node attempts[^obs-analytics].
implementation: Graph lifecycle emits carry warehouse correlators (`graph_id`, `recipe_id`, `authorization_epoch`, nest `parent_run_id` / `nest_depth`). `project_node_attempt_rows` projects attempt rows. `CliInstrumentor` verb `graph_event_correlators`.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/warehouse_correlators.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
